origin.description: Put the generator back when the frame exits, including when no seed was set.
origin.details: Draws inside the block do not advance the generator seen by the caller. An unset seed stays unset.
origin.value: The previous seed, or NULL when none was set.
origin.example:
set.seed(1)
before <- .Random.seed
local({
  local_preserve_seed()
  runif(4)
})
as.numeric(identical(.Random.seed, before))

translation.description: Put the generator back when the frame exits, including when no seed was set.
translation.details: Draws inside the block do not advance the generator seen by the caller. An unset seed stays unset. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.value: The previous seed, or NULL when none was set.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

from withr._rng import set_seed, snapshot
set_seed(1)
before = snapshot()
with local_preserve_seed():
    runif(4)
return int(snapshot() == before)
